proof_body:
by
  intro F f S hb hu
  choose c hc using hb
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hu 1 one_pos)
  have hsum : ∀ i, i ≤ N → |c i| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), |c j| := fun i hi =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |c j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
  have hf : ∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ |c N| + 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hN N le_rfl x hx
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
    have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f x) (F N x)
    have h3 := (hc N x hx).trans (le_abs_self _)
    linarith
  refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), |c j| + 2, fun x hx => ?_, fun n x hx => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hf x hx
    have h2 := hsum N le_rfl
    linarith
  · rcases le_total n N with hn | hn
    · have h1 := (hc n x hx).trans (le_abs_self _)
      have h2 := hsum n hn
      linarith
    · have h1 := hN n hn x hx
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h1
      have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (F n x) (f x)
      have h3 := hf x hx
      have h4 := hsum N le_rfl
      linarith
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), (∀ n, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ S, |F n x| ≤ c) → TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop S → ∃ K : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ K) ∧ ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S, |F n x| ≤ K
